_provenance: Carries Wyatt's 209 reviewed dispositions across the line-number-to-stable-id re-key. Authored from EVIDENCE IN GIT, not proximity: ddefa8f's inventory is the exact one his review page consumed, so every frozen id resolves there to an enclosing function and a curated role label. Old and new are matched on function plus position in file order, with the six pinned retirements removed from the old side first — never on copy text, because 15-06's D-29 conversion reworded the mpError and introBarrier lines and text matching would fail silently exactly where it looks like it is working (D-44). A row may be retired ONLY if its own export tag is `merge` — so a silent mass retirement is structurally impossible rather than merely unlikely.
